findings.severity: high within admitted extreme finite inputs
findings.mechanism: Intermediate time-difference overflow and rate*duration underflow were mistaken for complete decay or zero integrated forcing.
findings.repair: Scale finite opposite-sign endpoints before subtraction when duration overflows; evaluate the tiny-exponent primitive using the summed logarithmic product.
findings.verification: Independent reproduced counterexamples now pass; see INDEPENDENT_REPRO_FINAL.log.

findings.mechanism: beta*duration underflows before expm1, so division by nonzero beta leaves an incorrect zero phase instead of the constant-frequency limit.
findings.repair: Use the w*duration limit when the scaled exponent is zero and exprel near zero; use endpoint frequency for large growth and refuse nonrepresentable duration.
findings.verification: All 10 current chirp contracts and independent subnormal-beta probe pass.

findings.object: SwitchingSegment::proposed_next_step documentation / terminal DOPRI session carry
findings.reproduction: For y'=1, h0=.1, advance_to(.1) exports h=.1 with session tf=.1 but h=.5 with session tf=1 and .1 as a registered intermediate checkpoint; both use one attempt and reach identical t/state.
findings.mechanism: Dopri5Session breaks on t==tf before updating its controller proposal. run() makes each batch target the session tf. Completed batches therefore carry the terminal snapshot request; budget-stopped batches carry an updated proposal.
findings.impact: No error test is bypassed and equal-window clipping limits impact. Do not describe all completed-batch exports as newly computed post-final-error proposals.
findings.smallest_repair: Clarify terminal-snapshot semantics in field/factory docs. A future full-span session could update the proposal at actual intermediate checkpoints.
findings.evidence: Source inspection plus existing compiled vigilode rlib probe; output retained in TERMINAL_PROPOSAL_PROBE.log.
findings.repair: Carry-mode sessions now use the full solve endpoint and pause at the batch target; completed nonterminal targets therefore update the controller proposal. Full-solve terminal exports are None. Reaching a target exactly on the final batch attempt counts as batch success, while the global solve budget remains unchanged.
findings.verification: Independent 17-test selection harness passed, including original terminal-proposal counterexample, exact-target-on-last-attempt regression, existing switching and execution contracts.

findings.object: oscillatory_chart_pilot physical_local_atol label and common-budget wording
findings.reproduction: With two components, physical WRMS(atol=a, rtol=0)<=1 implies Linf embedded estimate<=sqrt(2)*a. Chart WRMS(atol=a/(sqrt(2)*maximum_lift))<=1 implies the transported physical Linf embedded estimate<=a.
findings.impact: The chart uses the stricter majorant, so this does not hide tolerance relaxation. The local Linf majorants are nonetheless not identical; endpoint accuracy-qualified comparisons remain valid in their stated scope.
findings.smallest_repair: Describe a as the nominal control parameter and state both majorants, or expose the actual physical local-estimator majorant in each row. No numerical rerun is required for a label-only correction.
findings.repair: Pilot header now explicitly distinguishes physical WRMS atol from the stricter chart physical-Linf sufficient local budget and keeps endpoint errors/cap separate.
findings.verification: Read corrected example header; no numerical rerun required for this description-only correction.
